info.title: PaymentsPlatform  FinancialAccountService - v2 Azure
info.description:
This API is only used by Payments Platform. This API enables the following functions and it is protected by Azure  
  • Create token for set of financial information
  • Retrieve masked financial information associated with a specific token

get.summary: Get financials for the provided token
get.description: Provides ability to retrieve masked financial information for tokens that have yet to expire.

parameters.name: AFI-AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application that is accessing the resource

parameters.name: tokenId
parameters.description: Token generated by financial account service which identifies the set of financial information desired.

parameters.name: consumerKey
parameters.description: Character string uniquely associated to the purpose of the payment request within the client application.  Maximum length:  20 characters

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: String that uniquely identifies this specific transaction.  Enabling traffic for this transaction to be traced through its various service calls.

400.description:
400001 - One or more required attributes are missing from request. Reasons include:
  • Financial token not provided
  • Consumer key not provided
  • Consumer's AppName not provided
400002 - One or more attributes failed to pass validation. Reasons include:
  • Token has invalid length or format
  • Token has expired
  • Consumer key or Transaction id has invalid length
  • Application name is not recognized

404.description: Financial account token matching search criteria was not found. This may occur if the token has expired, already been used, or if the consumer key provided doesn't match the one used to generate the token.

post.summary: Create a new financial account token
post.description: Validates financial information provided and returns a one-time use token representing this information.The lifespan of this token correlates to its business purpose. For example, the token for MyAccount Enrollment is set to ten days to give the customer time to reply to an e-mail and set up their MyAccount. The generated token used by My Account to create/modify customer’s payment account has a life span of one hour.

400.description:
400001 - Required attribute not provided in request. 400002 - Attribute failed validation. Specific causes can include:
  • Consumer key has invalid length
  • Transaction id has invalid length
  • Application name not recognized
  • Bank account number invalid length or contains non-alphanumeric characters
  • Routing number doesn't represent active bank
  • Invalid account use
  • Invalid account type
  • Bank account failed validation

get.description: Verifies service is available and able to access downstream services

parameters.name: Level
parameters.description:
Indicates how deep of ping is needed. For security reasons, this API only allows:  
  • None

MaskedFinancialAccount.title: MaskedFinancialAccount
MaskedFinancialAccount.description: High level entity representing a set of financial account information

MaskedBankAccount.title: MaskedBankAccount
MaskedBankAccount.description: High level information about bank account to be used for ACH withdrawal type

accountNumber.description:
Alphanumeric bank account number.  When included in response object, all but the last three digits will be masked from view.

Length:  3-17 digits.

accountType.description:
Type of bank account. Valid values include:  
  • Checking
  • Savings

accountUse.description:
How this bank account is used. Valid values include:  
  • Personal
  • Business

financialInstitution.description: Name of bank identified by routing number provided.

MaskedCreditCard.title: MaskedCreditCard
MaskedCreditCard.description: Encapsulates information representing a credit card.  As debit cards are currently processed as credit cards, this object will also used for debit cards for the foreseeable future.

cardNumber.description: Debit or credit card number, returned in masked format with only the last four digits visible.

cardType.description:
Credit card network. Derived from card number. Valid values include:  
  • VI (Visa)
  • MC (Mastercard)
  • DI (Discover)
  • AX (American Express)

consumerKey.description: Character string uniquely associated to the purpose of the financial token within the client application.
Character string uniquely associated to the purpose of the financial token.
